story_type: swimmer and basket lowered onto a moving tug far offshore
hook: A rescue swimmer lowered onto a moving tug, 28 miles out.
narration: This rescue swimmer rode the cable down onto a tug still plowing through the sea.
The tug Cape Ann was twenty-eight miles off Eureka, California, in August twenty twenty-four.
A man aboard needed to get to a hospital.
Crews ask the boat to hold a steady course and speed, so the pilot can hover in one spot above the deck.
Next, the basket went down the cable.
[short pause] It came back up with the man sitting inside.
Then the hoist pulled the swimmer back up off the deck.
outcome: The aircrew flew him to Eureka and handed him to medics at Saint Joseph Hospital.
title: Swimmer lowered onto a moving tug
description:
On Aug. 12, 2024, a Coast Guard helicopter aircrew hoisted a 35-year-old man off the tug Cape Ann about 28 miles northwest of Eureka, California, and transferred him to emergency medical services at Saint Joseph Hospital in Eureka.
